items.title: Dave Bennett interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 16, 2025
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I assume you watched “The Benny Goodman Story” with Steve Allen? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah.

ctx.x: working just the way he wanted it to do. And the guys were playing the way that he would prefer it. And it was probably harder for him later on to find guys that could recapture that the way that he wanted it. You know? I don’t know.
I assume you watched “The Benny Goodman Story” with Steve Allen?
